name: build-invoice-normalizer
hypothesis: A deterministic invoice/CSV normalizer has a real paying market (bookkeepers, SMB finance teams) and needs zero capital to serve.
notes: Built and verified: 31 unit (lib) + 27 e2e against a live HTTP server. Zero runtime dependencies, no LLM in the hot path, ~1-2ms for a 5-row file.

name: fix-splitter-delimiter-mismatch
hypothesis: Semi-colon and tab delimited European exports parse correctly.
metric: semicolon CSV parsed into correct columns
notes: FAILED then fixed. splitCsvLine() hardcoded a comma while detectDelimiter() chose a semicolon, so every EU/Arabic export collapsed into a single column. Silent data corruption on an entire market segment.

name: fix-total-subtotal-bleed
hypothesis: The total extractor does not match inside the word "Subtotal".
metric: total field correct on a receipt with subtotal+tax lines
notes: FAILED then fixed. /total/i matched inside "Subtotal" and the money extractor took the LARGEST number in a 60-character window. Now requires a standalone total token and takes the FIRST value.

name: fix-empty-cell-as-zero
hypothesis: Absent CSV cells do not produce spurious validation warnings.
notes: FAILED then fixed. toNumber("") returned 0, so every missing column looked like a legitimate zero and produced false TAX_RATE_MISMATCH and PARTIAL_PAYMENT warnings. An empty cell is now absent, not zero.

name: fix-html-mime-type
hypothesis: The landing page and playground render as HTML in a browser.
notes: FAILED then fixed. The response helper sent text/plain for string bodies, so browsers displayed raw source. Added a static file sender with a MIME map and verified in a real browser.

name: fix-rate-limit-throttles-paying-user
hypothesis: A customer processing a large batch is not throttled by the abuse limiter.
notes: FAILED then fixed. The limiter keyed on IP alone, so a legitimate bulk user was indistinguishable from a scraper and a paying customer could be blocked. Now keyed on API key and skipped entirely for paying plans; the credit meter is the real governor.

name: fix-sample-data-errors
hypothesis: The demo datasets shipped in the playground are arithmetically correct.
metric: intentional vs accidental errors in samples
metric_value: 2 of 3 reported errors were my own typos
notes: FAILED then fixed. A sample row carried 8 values against a 7-column header and another summed 500+100 as 610. A demo that cries wolf teaches the opposite lesson.

name: fix-jsonl-seed-written-as-csv
hypothesis: The committed ledger seed loads on a fresh deploy.
notes: FAILED then fixed. seed/experiments.jsonl was hand-written as comma-separated CSV with a comment header; every line failed JSON.parse and the public ledger came up empty in production. Now generated from a single canonical definition and self-verified.

name: fix-container-bind-and-ephemeral-data
hypothesis: The service is reachable and keeps customer state after a deploy.
notes: Bound to 127.0.0.1, which is unreachable on Railway/Render; and the JSON store sat on an ephemeral container filesystem, so every restart would have invalidated live API keys and paid credits. Now binds 0.0.0.0 on a container, honours DATA_DIR for a mounted volume, and warns loudly at boot if neither is configured.

name: settle-idempotency
hypothesis: A replayed payment confirmation cannot double-credit an account.
notes: Settlement is idempotent per order AND enforces global tx_ref uniqueness, so neither a client retry nor a reused transaction hash can mint free credits. Covered by end-to-end tests.
